title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2611.16661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. translated_title: 通过推理与环境协调减少LLM智能体工作负载的批量完成时间
translated_abstract: 智能体任务的高效批量执行对LLM训练和开发工作流至关重要，包括基准评估、合成数据生成和强化学习rollout。由于这些任务在LLM推理与环境交互之间交替进行，我们提出了协调优化方法来减少批量完成时间，即完成一批中所有任务所需的时间。对于混合LLM，基于工作负载的资源模型指导GPU显存在键值缓存（KV cache）与循环状态之间的分配，并提供参考样本并发度，在限制重计算的同时充分利用并行性。轨迹感知的路由与调度在平衡工作节点负载的同时促进缓存复用。在环境容量受限的情况下，我们将样本准入与环境执行解耦，并引入链推进动作调度（CAAS），该方法利用观察到的进展优先调度长链条，从而缩短批量的尾部延迟。受控回放结合了实际推理（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出推理与环境协调的优化方案——包括基于工作负载的GPU显存分配模型、轨迹感知路由调度以及优先推进长链条的链推进动作调度（CAAS）——显著减少了LLM智能体批量任务的总完成时间。
en_tdlr: This paper reduces batch makespan for LLM agent workloads through inference-environment coordination, combining workload-based GPU memory allocation, trajectory-aware routing and scheduling, and Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS) that prioritizes long chains to shorten the batch tail.
